svg.title: Taylanator (Taylanator-Question-ML-GAME)
svg.desc: Taylanator, repository Taylanator-Question-ML-GAME. An Akinator-style guessing game. It asks questions and uses machine learning to work out the animal, celebrity, game, film or object you have in mind. Python, Machine learning.
svg.text: An Akinator-style guessing game. It asks questions and uses machine learning to work out the animal, celebrity,
game, film or object you have in mind.
